name: Ramya Pandian
bio: Ramya Pandian is a south Indian actress who appears in Tamil language films. She made her film debut in 2013 through the Tamil short film ‘Maane Theyne Ponmaane’. She then acted in films like ‘Koondhalum Meesaiyum’ and ‘Dummy Tappasu’.

credits.title: Baththa
credits.overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.

credits.title: Arulvaan
credits.overview: Follows Muthuvel, a resolute collector who overcomes all obstacles to educate a tribal girl and provide school access for the entire forest community.

credits.title: Charukesi
credits.overview: A Carnatic musician with Alzheimer's grapples with his prodigal son's lifestyle choices, exploring the intersection of music, memory, and family relationships.

credits.title: Kayilan
credits.overview: The conflict between justice and the rule of law.

credits.title: Nanpakal Nerathu Mayakkam
credits.overview: A group of Malayali travellers, returning to Kerala by bus after their visit to Velankanni, all doze off in a lazy nap after lunch. credits.title: Raame Aandalum Raavane Aandalum
credits.overview: A villager's search for his two lost bulls turns his village to become breaking news on all the television channels in India,and into an expose of the corruption in politics and media.

credits.title: Aan Devathai
credits.overview: A husband and wife, who are poles apart, go through a lean patch after they start living separately.

credits.title: Joker
credits.overview: Mannar Mannan, an ordinary villager, decides to call himself the president of the country and starts fighting against the injustices he comes across in his society. What's his agenda?
